candidates.name: Git tag name + commit message in a public repo (what was built)

probe.detail: Probed against the live GitHub API on this repository's own pushes. PushEvent payload keys are [before, head, push_id, ref, repository_id] -- no commits key, removed by GitHub 2025-10-07 -- so the commit-message carrier reaches nobody. CreateEvent still carries the tag ref, so that carrier survives, but no tag has ever been created. Events API retention was also cut 90 days to 30 on 2025-01-30, so the surviving carrier has a hard expiry.

candidates.name: Sigstore Rekor / SCITT / Trillian transparency logs
candidates.probe: probed: not installed or run. Named by 5 reviewers as the adopt-rung answer; correct hardening layer, but each is a hosted service and none was exercised. Recorded as unprobed rather than dismissed.

reuse.capability: external, non-operator-controlled witness that a provenance packet set existed at a point in time
reuse.irreducible_delta: The set commitment over (identity, sequence, SAID) leaves is irreducible -- no surveyed candidate provides one; OpenTimestamps and Rekor attest a digest and cannot commit to a packet set. But the WITNESS half was not irreducible and should have been composed rather than built: the probe shows OpenTimestamps supplies exactly it, with no operator-controlled ref in the trust path and no 30-day expiry. The ladder verdict for the publication mechanism is compose, and the artifact as shipped is build. That is the review's core finding and it stands against this entry.

reviewer.outcome: REVISION REQUIRED -- NOT approved. 9 distinct reviewers, 68 findings, 31 after merge. Confirmed by reproduction: ANCHOR_STALE is a count comparison not a subset check (G4, 4 reviewers); the prev_root walk is specified and unimplemented (G5, 4 reviewers). Confirmed against live APIs: the commit-message witness carrier does not work (G6b) and Events retention is 30 days (G21). Unfixed: signer excluded from signed bytes (G1, 4 reviewers), key auto-mint with pinning off by default (G9). Against the design: the ladder was not satisfied for witnessing (G2, 6 reviewers) and the headline claim 'silent wholesale truncation impossible' is false once the operator republishes over a truncated store (G12). One reviewer (GROK/F11) concluded it should not ship in this form; that position is not yet refuted.

candidates.name: Kish effective sample size (arXiv:2605.29800 section 3.3)
candidates.probe: probed: read the method section in full; formula is n_eff = k / (1 + (k-1) * mean_phi) over binary vectors, plus an eigenvalue variant k / lambda_max. Adopted both verbatim.

candidates.name: numpy / scipy for the eigenvalue computation
candidates.probe: probed: neither is declared in requirements-ci.txt or ARF/requirements.txt. Rejected -- adding a numeric stack to compute the largest eigenvalue of a matrix with k under ten would itself be a reuse-gate violation. 12-line power iteration instead.

candidates.name: krippendorff / statsmodels inter-rater agreement (alpha, Fleiss kappa)
candidates.probe: probed: these measure inter-rater RELIABILITY, which is a different quantity. arXiv:2605.29800 section 3.3 rejects kappa explicitly -- it 'conflates prevalence with dependence; phi isolates the linear dependence that directly degrades majority-vote performance'. Using a kappa library would compute the wrong number.

reuse.capability: measure effective independence of a review panel without gold labels
reuse.irreducible_delta: The published method builds binary vectors from errors against gold labels. This project has no gold labels, so the item set is the union of findings raised and the vectors are 'did you raise this'. That measures redundancy, not accuracy, and the deviation is stated in the module docstring and the protocol doc so the number is never cited as the paper's own result.
